# A clause that never says how much it binds

`Policy: pol-MODA` `DRAFT`

## Purpose

A sentence in a clause table is not a clause. Without a modal there is nothing to say whether this is an
obligation, a recommendation or an ambition, and the row cannot be answered by a standard that does not know
which it is being held to.

## Scope

This fixture only. It exists so `clause-modal` is exercised where no modal opens the row.

## Clauses

| Id      | Clause                                          | Alignment |
|---------|-------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| `CLEAN` | We will trigger `clause-modal` and nothing else |           |
